claim: The effect size (absolute difference in DNA methylation between controls and PDB cases) was significantly higher for sites from the Best subset (mean ± SD; 0.011 ± 0.019) compared to the rest of those in the Pooled sites (0.007 ± 0.01; p-value=1.9×10−3).

evidence: This is a description of the study cohort.

claim: The PRISM trial is a multi-center study in which participants were recruited from 27 different clinical centers across the United Kingdom.
source: The PRISM trial is a multi-center study in which participants were recruited from 27 different clinical centers across the United Kingdom.
evidence: This is a description of the study design.

claim: The epigenetic analysis was conducted in 253 cases with clinical and radiological evidence of PDB and 280 controls.
source: The epigenetic analysis was conducted in 253 cases with clinical and radiological evidence of PDB and 280 controls who were spouses of PDB cases (n = 135) or subjects who had been referred for investigation of osteoporosis but had normal bone density upon examination by dual-energy X-ray absorptiometry (n = 131).
evidence: This is a description of the study cohort.

claim: Controls included spouses of PDB cases (n = 135) or subjects who had been referred for investigation of osteoporosis but had normal bone density upon examination by dual-energy X-ray absorptiometry (n = 131).

claim: A 10% difference in the mean of CpG methylation level between cases and controls at genome-wide significance level of 10−6 requires 112 individuals in each group to achieve 80% EWAS power.
source: According to the study by Tsai and Bell, a 10% difference in the mean of CpG methylation level between cases and controls at genome-wide significance level of 10−6 requires 112 individuals in each group to achieve 80% EWAS power (Tsai and Bell, 2015).
evidence: This claim is supported by a citation to a power calculation study.

claim: The discovery set comprising of 116 cases and 130 controls is adequately powered.
source: On this basis, our discovery set comprising of 116 cases and 130 controls is adequately powered, and the results are further validated in an equally sized cross-validation set.
evidence: This claim is based on inference from the power calculation cited.

evidence: This claim is based on a citation to previous literature.
